name: Khattat – Arabic Fonts
author: Mokhtar Bensaid

sections.description:
اختر خطًا عربيًا جميلًا لموقعك من بين أكثر من 110 خط رائع لتحسين تجربة المستخدم.
القاهرة، لطيف، تجول، أميري، روبيك، سكاي… وغيرها من الخطوط الجميلة.

تم إضافة الخط السعودي الرسمي الجديد الذي تم الإعلان عليه

Choose a beautiful Arabic font for your site from over 110 stunning fonts to enhance user experience.
Cairo, Lateef, Tajawal, Amiri, Rubik, Sky… and others beautiful fonts.

The new official Saudi font announced has been added.

Key Features

  • Beautiful arabic fonts.
  • Select custom font for each element: body, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6.
  • Translation ready of the plugin strings to arabic see language folder from the plugin root folder.

This plugin helped website owners who have an Arabic language website

Font Ressources

  • Font Face
  • Google Fonts
  • My GitHub Repository Saudi Font
  • My GitHub Repository Rare Arabic Fonts

Translations

  • Arabic
sections.installation:
1. Upload the khattat-arabic-fonts folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Appearrance=> Customize => Khattat Arabic Fonts” then work on the fonts.
sections.faq:
What is this plugin for?

For choosing beautiful fonts to Arabic websites with the possibility of customize each element with custom font.

How many fonts are available?

There are over 110 stunning Arabic fonts available.
